name: Flutter Development Environment
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git curl unzip xz-utils zip libglu1-mesa && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 /opt/flutter && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /opt/flutter && echo 'export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin"' >> ~/.bashrc && export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin" && flutter doctor
